story: Our family owned business has been serving the local community and new faces alike since 1981, providing a warm family atmosphere. You will be pleased with our menu variety. From breakfast served all day, lunch specials, steaks & seafood to homemade comfort food. Always with a smile and a warm heart. Come enjoy your family & friends with us. Schedule your events.
